title: Senior 3D Generalist Artist - 6 month contract
description:
We’re a games studio focused on building games that bring people together.
We believe that games that deliver the most fun-per-minute have the highest chance of success. We are a start-up and not a big company, which means we’re a bit scrappy but we’re resourceful, highly collaborative and focused on outcomes and shipping builds over process and meetings.
We aim to hire multi-talented individuals who can operate autonomously and at speed, with every role at the studio being hands-on working directly on our games.
Role Overview
We’re looking to bring on a Senior 3D Generalist Artist for a 6 month contract, with potential to extend further depending on how things go.
We’re looking for a Senior 3D Generalist Artist that has experience building modular environments and character art, to contribute to art production on an exciting unannounced co-op combat game.
Key Responsibilities
1 - Create Game-Ready Art
You’ll mainly be working on modular environments, props, set dressing and character / creature work.
Success looks like:

• Understanding our art ethos and working autonomously with high level direction

• Grasping the project art style and adapting quickly

• Understanding how to construct modular environments and working to a grid

• Rapid output by focusing on getting the core elements right rather than superficial details

2 - Be a Force Multiplayer, Not Just an Asset Maker
There’s more to it than just creating assets, it’s about being an invaluable team member.
Success looks like:

• Communicating and collaborating with the team. Nurturing the synergy between disciplines and problem solving the gaps in-between

• Joining playtests and contributing to the game experience beyond art

• Identifying risks and constraints early and redirecting effort when needed

• Being pro-active and moving the project forward, even if you’re waiting for feedback or currently blocked, you know how to identify meaningful work to keep momentum

3 - Implement Assets in Engine
You’re not just handing off art assets, you’re implementing them in-engine.
Success looks like:

• Importing, setting up and hooking up assets

• Correctly handling setup for materials, prefabs, folders and naming etc

• Fixing materials, collision and general art bugs in engine

• Spotting inefficiencies and offering better solutions

• Keeping assets and scenes well optimized without sacrificing the game’s vision

Requirements

• Senior experience level. Comfortable working autonomously with high level direction, championing your area of responsibility

• Broad artistic & technical skillset: environments, props, characters / creatures

• Confident in Unity; asset implementation and fixing art bugs

• Comfortable in Blender (preferred) or able to transition quickly

• Happy to prioritize speed & efficiency

• Project first mindset: Our games look good but we’re not trying to win art awards or build stunning portfolio pieces. The experience is king.

• General understanding of supporting optimization and performance for online multiplayer titles (from an art POV)

• Bonus skills: Rigging, VFX, UI, Tech Art skills, Concept Art

Please note: This is a 6 month contract, remote-working position, open to anyone within the UK.

title: Software Engineer — Engineering Systems, Continuous Integration
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

ABOUT SNOWFLAKE

Snowflake is building the AI Data Cloud, enabling organizations around the world to mobilize data and develop applications at global scale. The Engineering Systems organization builds the tools, infrastructure, and platforms that help Snowflake engineers develop, test, and deliver high-quality software efficiently.

The Continuous Integration team is responsible for the systems that power builds, tests, validation, and developer workflows across Snowflake's engineering organization. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will help build reliable, scalable CI services that support thousands of engineers and a rapidly growing multi-cloud codebase.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design, develop, test, and operate distributed systems that power Snowflake's continuous integration platform.

- Build services and tooling that improve build reliability, test execution, developer productivity, and software delivery velocity.

- Contribute to the architecture and implementation of scalable CI infrastructure across cloud environments.

- Develop reliable APIs, services, and automation using languages such as Java, C++, Python, or Go.

- Investigate and resolve issues involving build failures, test infrastructure, performance, reliability, and developer workflows.

- Partner with engineers across Snowflake to understand CI needs and deliver solutions that are simple, scalable, and easy to operate.

- Participate in design reviews, code reviews, testing, and production support.

- Apply strong engineering judgment to improve system performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.

- Help evolve CI practices, tooling, and operational processes as Snowflake grows.

- Contribute to an inclusive engineering culture through collaboration, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE

- 3+ years of software engineering experience building production systems.

- Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

- Experience designing and implementing reliable software services.

- Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, C++, Python, or Go.

- Familiarity with cloud-based development environments and distributed applications.

- Experience with testing, debugging, monitoring, and operating production systems.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work through ambiguous technical challenges.

- Effective written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to collaborate with engineers, product partners, and teams across the organization.

- A strong sense of ownership and commitment to delivering high-quality software.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with continuous integration, continuous delivery, or developer productivity systems.

- Familiarity with tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Bazel, or similar CI/CD platforms.

- Experience with build systems, test orchestration, distributed job scheduling, or resource management.

- Knowledge of multi-tenant systems, reliability engineering, performance optimization, or security isolation.

- Experience working with Kubernetes, containers, or public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

- Experience supporting large-scale repositories, build pipelines, or engineer

title: Aviation Compliance Analyst- Africa
description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

ABOUT YOU AND THE ROLE
Zipline is looking for an Aviation Compliance Analyst to support aviation regulatory compliance across our Africa operations. This role will help ensure that Zipline ’s flight operations, site operations, regulatory submissions, reporting practices, and internal compliance processes remain aligned with applicable aviation requirements and Zipline ’s safety and operational standards.
You will work closely with the Global Aviation team, Africa regulatory and operations teams, and country leadership. The role may be remote, but it will require regular travel to Zipline nests and operational sites across Africa to support implementation, audits, regulatory engagement, documentation, and cross-functional training.
This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable moving between detailed compliance work and practical operational execution. The right candidate will be able to understand regulatory requirements, translate them into clear operating practices, build trust with internal and external stakeholders, and help teams maintain compliance in a fast-moving aviation environment. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-growing, multi-country aviation environment where structure, audit readiness and regulatory discipline are essential to operational scale.
This role is remote and includes substantial travel across the African countries in which Zipline operates.
WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Assist cross-functional teams in preparing regulatory approval packages, documenting conditions of approval, and maintaining post-approval compliance records.

• Maintain and update aviation manuals, regulatory documents, and operating materials to align with approved operations and applicable regulations.

• Format, organize, and version-control materials required for regulatory approvals, audits, inspections, and internal reviews through Zipline ’s aviation compliance portal.

• Maintain compliance dashboards, trackers, and structured datasets covering licenses, permits, certificates, approvals, renewals, regulatory commitments, operational limitations, special conditions, open actions, and upcoming deadlines across multiple countries.

• Support compliance monitoring activities, including audit readiness, findings management, non-compliance tracking, CAPA follow-up, and closure-evidence capture.

title: HUBZone General Consideration
description:
About Hunter Strategy
Hunter Strategy has a unique philosophy to technical project delivery. We treat all our customers like mission partners because they rely on our team to meet their objectives through complex software engineering, cloud operations, and cyber risk management solutions. Hunter Strategy was founded on the premise that IT is 21st century infrastructure - critically important but only instrumentally valuable. Accordingly, our teams look at problems with a single objective: the identification and enablement of the right capability to address the most vexing problems our Mission Partners face. We continue to support our partners' success by leveraging the right technology, with the right plan, and the right team to address tomorrow's challenges today.
As a HUBZone-certified company, this general consideration posting is intended for candidates who may be eligible for current and future opportunities across our teams.
Why Apply Here
Great talent doesn’t always align perfectly with open roles and we don’t want to miss the opportunity to connect.
This general application allows you to join our HUBZone talent pipeline. When new contracts are awarded or positions open, we look here first to identify candidates who are already aligned with our work and mission.

Areas We Typically Hire In
We regularly hire across a variety of disciplines, including:

• Cybersecurity (engineering, analysis, compliance, operations)

• Cloud (architecture, engineering, migration, managed services)

• Software Development (full-stack, DevSecOps, systems integration)

• Program & Project Management

• Contracts, Procurement & Compliance

• IT Operations & Managed Services

• Administrative & Operations Support

HUBZone Residency
Hunter Strategy is headquartered in a designated HUBZone, and our certification is central to how we compete for and win work that benefits our clients and our community. To maintain this certification, at least 35% of our workforce must live in a federally designated HUBZone - making where you live an important part of our hiring picture.
If you’re not sure whether your address qualifies, you can check using the SBA’s HUBZone map.

Hunter Strategy may verify HUBZone residency as part of the hiring process. Hunter Strategy is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Compensation Lead

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.
We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.
The Role
Abridge is looking for an experienced Compensation Lead to own our compensation strategy, building a competitive, scalable framework that helps us attract, motivate, and reward our people as we grow. This is a foundational hire for our People Operations team.
We're looking for someone who moves fast, takes ownership, and makes sound decisions backed by data and experience, someone who stays ahead of the market rather than reacting to it.
What You’ll Do

• Conduct market benchmarking and modeling, using the right peer groups, to support compensation program design and decision-making.

• Advise on sales and other GTM compensation design, including OTE structuring.

• Partner with Finance and Recruiting to design and govern salary structures, incentive plans, and exception criteria, and own the clean flow of that data to Finance for budgeting.

• Build the frameworks, tools, and governance we need to scale compensation as Abridge grows and our programs mature.

• Proactively track market movement and trends in the AI space, so we're never caught off guard.

What You’ll Bring

• 6+ years of compensation experience, ideally at a high-growth tech or AI company, with real ownership of program build, not just an analytical role.

• Deep Excel fluency (modeling, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, etc) and the ability to turn messy data into insights the business can actually use.

• A track record of building benchmarking approaches and peer groups that hold up under scrutiny, and the judgment to know when the standard playbook doesn't fit.

• Strong fluency in sales compensation: OTE design, bonus structuring, and the tradeoffs that come with them.

• Command of compensation fundamentals such as job matching, market pricing, leveling and job architecture, and cyclical programs

• Experience designing and owning compensation and equity frameworks, including at the executive level, across public and private company structures.

• Excellent communication skills: the ability to turn dense analysis into something any business leader can understand and act on.

title: Principal Technical Account Manager
description:
A Little About Us

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www. enterprisedb .com

EDB is hiring a Principal Technical Account Manager (TAM) for US. The Principal TAM is responsible for building and maintaining post-sales relationships with EDB’s largest and most complex customers. These customers are typically large accounts adopting Postgres and AI solutions. The Principal TAM serves as a trusted technical advisor to drive successful outcomes and to ensure that the customers become a positive reference and continue their journey on Postgres technology. The Principal TAM is also the customer's primary point of contact into all technical areas of EDB. As such, the Principal TAM’s technical abilities are critical in identifying solutions, architecture, troubleshooting issues, and answering technical questions as they arise.
What you will do…

• Establish a close working relationship with the customer’s senior technical leadership team and become their trusted advisor.

• Help EDB customers maximize the value of their Postgres investment

• Assist EDB customers to develop and deploy Postgres strategies

• Provide technical leadership for the customer's major Postgres initiatives (This may include solutions consulting, architecture guidance, and project management)

• Maintain current functional and technical knowledge of the entire EDB product line

• Provide clear and constructive product feedback to EDB’s product management teams based on customer requirements

• Help to document best practices in developing and deploying EDB solutions

• Function as a front-line technical resource for "best practice" and informal customer questions

• Travel up to 25% of the time as required

What will give you an edge…

• At least ten (10) years of hands-on experience with Postgres, Oracle, DB2 or MS SQL Server; professional certifications in any of the relational databases are desirable

• Advanced technical skills, specifically in data management platforms, operating systems, cloud technologies, and technical architecture

• Knowledgeable about data analytics and AI/ML concepts

• Experience with Kubernetes

• Excellent analytical skills regarding technical and project management issues

• Good understanding of strategic sales process

• Well-developed organizational skills with an ability to manage competing client demands

• Excellent communications and interpersonal skills, including ability to interact and communicate with CxO level personnel

• Bachelors/Masters degree in Information Technology / Computer science or equivalent technical training or industry experience preferred

EDB is committed to supporting our employees' overall well being by offering a range of benefits and resources to promote a healthy work-life balance and wellness. We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits.

title: Langfuse - Product Manager
description:
Langfuse is hiring its first Product Manager. You will work with the founders to define the product vision and set the strategic direction. You will also work with Solution Architects, sales, and marketing. Your input will help shape product decisions.

Engineers at Langfuse own delivery from start to finish. They help find solutions and turn them into technical requirements. They implement and launch the work. They support each launch with documentation and changelogs. They also speak directly with customers to receive feedback on features and educate the roadmap. The whole company helps shape the quarterly roadmap. The engineering team then delivers it.

As Product Manager, you will look beyond the current quarter. You will build a deep understanding of our market and emerging trends. You will also study how engineers use AI to build agentic applications. You will use these insights to create clear product artifacts. They will define the user problems we want to solve and how we want to solve them.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT LANGFUSE:

- Shape the product direction and translate long-term opportunities into clear priorities.

- Turn customer, community, and market insights into decisions about what to build and what not to build.

- Lead new product areas from research and scoping through launch.

- Work closely with founders, engineers, designers on APIs, SDKs, infrastructure, UX, and documentation.

- Align founders, engineering, sales, marketing, and key customers without introducing unnecessary processes.

- Make the product-engineering team more effective through clear context, strong judgment, and concise written briefs.

- You will own the quarterly roadmapping process and propose in which direction we should develop Langfuse.

WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO:

- Project Management for engineers. Everyone here can organize themselves, you do not need to do this.

- Slice large projects into Linear tickets. Single engineers execute on large projects in Langfuse.

- Communicate between customers and engineers. Engineers talk to customers daily.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

- An experienced PM from developer tools, observability, infrastructure, data, or a similarly technical product.

- Technical enough to reason credibly about APIs, SDKs, architecture, and UX tradeoffs.

title: Sales Account Executive: Data & Snowflake Services
description:
At Trifecta, we are more than just a technology company. We are a community of innovators, collaborators, and problem solvers dedicated to driving positive change in the world of technology. We are a dynamic organization that embraces diversity, fosters inclusion, and values the unique contributions of each of our Teammates. At Trifecta you will find a supportive and inclusive culture, endless opportunities for growth and development, and a vibrant community of passionate professionals dedicated to shaping the future.

We've been building and integrating enterprise systems for over 30 years. We're a Select Snowflake Partner with delivery practices across Snowflake, Salesforce, Salsify, AI, and custom development. Our consultants ship real work - that's what you'll be selling.

About The Role

As a Sales Account Executive, you'll own new business for our Snowflake and data services practice. You'll build pipeline, run complex sales cycles, and turn prospects into long-term clients.

Your best target list is companies that already own Snowflake. Budget is committed, and plenty of them stalled after the first migration - idle workloads, cost overruns, governance gaps, AI plans with no data foundation underneath. Your job is to find them, understand where they got stuck, and sell the work that unsticks them.

This role is for someone who generates their own pipeline, gets comfortable fast with technical buyers, and would rather scope a deal honestly than oversell it. As well someone who wants to continue to leverage their Snowflake experience.

What You'll Do

•
Prospect into the Snowflake install base. Find companies running Snowflake that aren't getting value from it. Outbound, referrals, Snowflake introductions - whatever gets you in the room. Qualify hard on where they're actually stuck.

•
Get wired into Snowflake's field org. Not just the AE. Their Customer Success teams see which accounts flatlined on consumption and are measured on fixing it - that's the same problem you're solving, so bring them a path. Same with their SEs, PS org, and partner managers. Know their quarter, know how they're paid, and make them look good.

•
Build your own top of funnel. Partner referrals are leverage, not a plan. You're expected to generate pipeline through disciplined outbound into target accounts.

•
Run full sales cycles. Discovery through negotiation and close. Multi-thread across the client's data, IT, and business leadership - and across Snowflake's team at the same time.

•
Scope honestly. You'll work directly with our delivery leads to size engagements. We'd rather lose a deal than sell something we can't deliver well. Our references are the reason we win the next one.

•
Sell consumption, not just projects. Frame engagements around the workloads they unlock and the platform spend they drive. That's how Snowflake evaluates partners, and how you get fed more deals.

•
Hit your number. Meet or exceed quota, keep the CRM current, and tell us what you're hearing in the market.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of B2B sales with a real outbound track record - self-sourced pipeline, not just closing marketing leads.

• Proven experience selling professional services on data and/or analytics projects. Scoped engagements, not software licenses.

• Experience selling to C-level and VP buyers across both IT and the business.

• Working knowledge of the modern data stack. You don't need to write SQL, but you should hold your own on warehouse compute and cost, migrations off legacy platforms (Redshift, Teradata, on-prem EDW), and where data projects go sideways.

• Solid foundational knowledge of how professional services engagements are sold and delivered.

• Ability to articulate a POV and value add of Snowflake and other data related services.

• Proficiency in CRM tools and running a disciplined pipeline.

• Ability to travel as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Existing relationships inside Snowflake's field organization - AE, SE, C

As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. At Wiz, we're passionate about technical sales and helping our partners and their customers achieve maximum value. We don't react to trends, we set the standard.  As a Partner Solutions Architect (MSP) , you won't just be supporting sales deals; you will influence and execute our technical MSP strategy from the ground up. Sitting at the absolute bleeding edge of technology, you will serve as the lead technical strategist empowering top-tier Managed Service Providers to rethink cloud security, package high-margin Wiz-powered offerings, and protect their clients' multi-cloud estates with the power of the Wiz Security Graph and our agentless architecture.

title: VP Quality and Accreditation
description:
The Vice President, Quality & Accreditation is the enterprise executive accountable for clinical quality performance across all lines of business, including Medicare and Commercial. This role owns HEDIS strategy and operations, accreditation (NCQA, URAC, and applicable state/federal standards), clinical quality programs, and the vendor ecosystem that supports HEDIS data collection, abstraction, and reporting.
This executive unifies quality functions historically siloed by line of business into a single operating model, ensuring consistent measurement, documentation, and improvement practices across Medicare and Commercial populations.
The role is accountable for HEDIS rates and audit results, accreditation status and survey outcomes, clinical quality program performance, and vendor ecosystem governance and cost.
Key Responsibilities:
Enterprise Quality Leadership & Operating Model
• Build a unified quality operating model across all lines of business, including Medicare and Commercial.
• Establish enterprise governance for clinical documentation integrity supporting quality measurement.
• Serve as the executive owner of enterprise HEDIS performance and accreditation status.
• Oversee all HEDIS operations, hybrid strategy, supplemental data, and provider documentation improvement, across Medicare and Commercial lines of business.
• Develop best-in-class intervention playbooks for each HEDIS measure.
Clinical Quality

• Lead enterprise clinical quality programs, including quality improvement initiatives, clinical practice guideline adoption, and provider quality performance programs.
• Ensure alignment with care management and population health functions on shared clinical priorities.
• Partner with COO, CFO, Network, Pharmacy, Stars, Risk Adjustment, and Operations leadership to ensure quality initiatives are coordinated enterprise-wide without assuming accountability for their respective programs.
Accreditation
• Own enterprise accreditation strategy and execution, including NCQA Health Plan Accreditation, URAC, and other applicable state and federal accreditation or certification requirements.
• Lead survey readiness, documentation, and corrective action planning for all accreditation activities.
• Maintain accreditation standards as they evolve and ensure organizational readiness for renewal cycles.
HEDIS Vendor Ecosystem Leadership
• Serve as the executive owner of the vendor ecosystem supporting HEDIS data collection, medical record retrieval, abstraction, and supplemental data.
• Consolidate and manage HEDIS vendors to reduce cost, improve data quality, and strengthen audit defensibility.
• Establish unified SLAs, KPIs, and performance governance for HEDIS-related vendors.
• Ensure vendors operate as extensions of the internal quality team.
Quality Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting
• Ensure data quality, timeliness, and integration across clinical, operational, and vendor systems supporting quality measurement.
• In partnership with Health Services Analytics, build a unified reporting architecture for HEDIS, accreditation, and clinical quality programs.
Governance & Compliance
• Ensure compliance with NCQA, URAC, and applicable regulatory requirements governing quality and accreditation.
• Lead enterprise audit readiness for HEDIS and accreditation surveys.
• Establish governance structures for decision-making, escalation, and cross-functional alignment on quality matters.

Key Requirements:
• 10+ years of leadership experience in health plan Quality, HEDIS, and Accreditation, across Medicare and Commercial lines of business.
• Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, public health, business, or related field preferred.
• Proven track record of improving HEDIS rates and achieving strong NCQA/URAC accreditation outcomes.
• Deep knowledge of HEDIS technical specifications, NCQA accreditation standards, and clinical quality improvement methodology.
• Experience leading large cross-functional teams and complex vendor

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

As a Principal Product Security Researcher at Chainguard, you’ll lead our product security research function end-to-end: mapping emerging threats, turning insight into strategy, and helping Chainguard stay several moves ahead of attackers across our entire product portfolio.

Chainguard prioritizes our customers’ security above all else, which means preparing not just for the attacks of today, but for those of tomorrow as well. In this Principal-level role, you’ll:

• Own the product security research agenda for Chainguard scanning the broader ecosystem, identifying emerging attack patterns, and translating them into clear risks and opportunities for Chainguard and our customers.

• Shape security direction across products and platforms, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Security leadership to embed your findings into roadmaps, architecture decisions, and long-term plans.

• Drive the agenda and discussion topics across the whole industry, helping everyone to understand what is important, where the risks are, and why they should pay attention.

•  

If you enjoy turning ambiguous, fast-moving threat intel into concrete, multi-quarter plans that change how a company operates, this is your playground.

The Coding Auditor works under the general direction of the Coding Supervisor. A Coding Auditor is responsible for reviewing encounters in either a prebill or retrospective workflow to validate a coding profile. Auditors evaluate compliance with all coding guidelines including but not limited to: Internal Coding policies/procedures/handbook, American Hospital Association (AHA) and American Medical Association (AMA) coding references, local, State, and Federal Coding Guidelines. • Assist in improved data quality for reporting and research, accurate billing and reimbursement of services rendered which overall improves the quality of care for the patient.

• Provide 1:1 and small group education sessions, facilitate round table discussions, contribute content to the coding newsletter, provide basic level trending or data review for opportunities.

We are seeking a Configuration Management Specialist to support a public sector health system's transition to a single provincial Clinical Information System. This role will focus on establishing and operationalizing configuration, role design, access management, and governance capabilities required to support the new system. The ideal candidate will be responsible for understanding current-state workflows and access models, defining future-state configuration and role structures, developing governance and operational processes, identifying gaps and risks, and coordinating implementation activities across partner organizations. The role encompasses current-state assessments, future-state design, requirements gathering, stakeholder engagement, configuration governance, role and access processes, and operational readiness activities. You will work closely with system architects, verification engineers, software developers, and hardware specialists, driving technical decisions and contributing to the development of proprietary digital IP.

title: Copy of Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.

Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment.

The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control.

You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. The patterns you set there become defaults the rest of the team builds on.

Day to day, that looks like:

- Owning the architecture: auth and identity flows, multi-tenancy, how data moves and where it's allowed to live, performance, and what happens in production

- Running what you build. Which means owning the infrastructure, CI, deployment, observability behind it and on-call

- Working on top of external platforms you can't change, and being straight about which risks are yours to manage and which aren't

- Partnering closely with the internal teams whose services you depend on: iterating on product requirements, agreeing on interfaces and protocols, and proactively finding ways to keep moving

ABOUT YOU

These are the attributes of someone who will perform well in this role:

- 8+ years building software, with a good chunk of it on data-heavy or integration-flavored systems

- Preferably proficient in TypeScript or Go or comfortable contributing to each

- Solid backend and systems instincts. You can reason about deployment topology, multi-tenancy, and data movement, and you're comfortable owning architectural tradeoffs you'll have to live with later

- You've worked with modern auth protocols, service principals, and identity federation, and you know how to get it right across a trust boundary

- You've built on someone else's platform and know what that's actually like: incomplete docs, unintended breaking changes, etc.

- You're comfortable in ambiguity. You can ship before the spec is finished, make sensible calls under uncertainty, and flag the decisions that'll be hard to undo to your team before we bake them in.

- You're good with other engineers. Much of the work runs through teams you don't own, and you earn their trust by how you think, not just what you commit.

- You're mainly a backend engineer, but you're comfortable enough to touch a modern React app

- You use AI tools well and honestly. Reach for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or whatever helps, and be clear about where you did and didn't

- You write well. Most of how we coordinate happens async in chats, design docs and RFCs

NICE TO HAVE

None of these are required, but any of them would be a bonus:

- Close familiarity with a major cloud data or analytics platform ecosystem

- Real depth in auth and identity federation, or experience building to

title: Complaints Handler
description:
ABOUT ZEGO 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Zego-Insurance-EI_IE1851459.11,25.htm.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Purpose of the role

Complaints are where things get real - the customer is already frustrated or in distress, the stakes are higher, and poor handling has direct regulatory consequences.

As a Complaints Handler, you'll own a caseload of customer complaints from acknowledgement through to final response. You'll investigate thoroughly, reach fair outcomes, and explain them clearly, all in line with DISP and Consumer Duty - and you'll take pride in getting it right for the customer first time.

You'll report to the Complaints Team Leader and work closely with teams across Claims, Fraud, Customer Support, and Sales to get to the right answer and fix the root cause.

Case Handling

- Own and resolve a caseload of customer complaints following initial acknowledgement

- Investigate each complaint thoroughly, analysing all the facts and related documentation

- Gather the information you need from internal teams and external partners

- Draft Final Response Letters that are clear, fair, and evidence a full investigation

- Keep customers informed throughout and manage expectations along the way

- Stay in control of your workload by actively monitoring and updating case management systems

Quality & Compliance

- Keep complaints logged, acknowledged, and progressed within DISP timescales

- Apply Consumer Duty and vulnerable customer standards consistently across every case

- Escalate complex, sensitive, or high-risk cases to your Team Leader promptly

- Support complaints reporting to management, senior leaders, QA assessors, and Compliance

Collaboration

- Work with Claims, Fraud, Customer Support, and Sales to resolve complaints and address root causes

- Contribute to feedback sessions, process improvement discussions, and complaint trend insight

What you will need to be successful

Essential

- Proven experience handling complaints end to end within an FCA-regulated environment, ideally motor insurance.

- Working knowledge of DISP and Consumer Duty as they apply to complaint handling.

- Clear, concise written communication, and the emotional intelligence to handle difficult conversations well.

- An analytical, organised approach - you can balance multiple priorities and deliver within SLAs.

- You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to be an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

Desirable

title: Principal Economist
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay is a marketplace for delivery work. Every day, 400,000 parcels move through our network, carried by couriers who choose when and how they work, across four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

When we offer a courier work, the price is part of the offer. Price it too low and routes go unserved; price it too high and the network pays for capacity it didn't need. Science at Relay brings operational research, machine learning, causal inference and economics together to optimise the whole network rather than one decision at a time. Economics decides what the work is worth.

MARKETPLACE HIGHLIGHTS

- Four marketplaces, four apps, each with its own economics.

- A live, two-sided marketplace where couriers choose their work, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

- Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-run behaviour are the norm, not the exception.

- Prices sit inside recommendations and network-wide optimisation, so economics, personalisation and operational research have to work as one.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Principal Economist at Relay, you'll:

- Own courier pricing and pay policy: how work is priced, how couriers are paid, and how incentives are set across our marketplaces.

- Apply economic theory to a live marketplace: model supply, demand and courier behaviour, and design pricing and incentive mechanisms that hold up in the real network.

- Measure what every pricing and pay change did, working with our Applied Scientists and experimenting across a live two-sided marketplace.

- Partner with Operational Research and Recommender Systems so price is set as part of the recommendation, not after it.

- Advise leadership on pricing and incentives, and help build Relay's research culture and voice in the tech community.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have a PhD in economics, and have applied it in a tech marketplace such as ride-hailing, delivery or a gig platform.

- Have advised leadership on pricing or incentive decisions, and seen those decisions through to what happened next.

- Are deeply skilled in econometrics and causal inference, and know how to apply economic theory to a real marketplace, not just a model of one.

- Are hands-on: you write the code, run the analysis and build the models yourself.

- Explain economics clearly to operations, product and leadership, without the jargon.

Who Thrives at Relay?

- Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

- Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

- 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

- All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

AlphaGov is hiring a Classification and Compensation Specialist to strengthen job and pay structures for public libraries and comparable public-sector organizations. You will combine job evaluation, market analysis and employee input to improve equity, consistency and compensation administration.

• Engage HR, employees, supervisors, leadership and union representatives through planned virtual and in-person activities.

• Develop implementation costs and timing, prepare draft and final reports, and explain recommendations to decision-makers.

• Train staff in the job-evaluation methodology so the organization can maintain the system.

Apply to be considered.
Requirements

Required

• At least five years of relevant classification and compensation consulting experience.

• Experience in job analysis, position evaluation, salary benchmarking and compensation-structure development.

• Ability to evaluate internal equity and salary compression and translate findings into practical pay recommendations.

• Working knowledge of ADA and FLSA considerations in job descriptions and ability to assess applicable occupational qualification requirements.

• Ability to engage employee and management stakeholders, communicate findings and document an implementable study.

Nice to have

title: Setter - 11/10/2026 post
description:
TIRED OF DIALING PEOPLE WHO NEVER ASKED TO HEAR FROM YOU?

At Curvion Blue, every lead you call has already raised their hand. They’ve watched a webinar, clicked an ad, or joined a funnel for a high ticket program ranging from $7k-$15k+. Your job is to turn that interest into qualified appointments for our closers, and to build the skills that will make you a closer yourself.

No cold lists. No door knocking. No guessing who to call. Just warm conversations, real coaching, and a clear runway to the next level.

Who We Are

Curvion Blue builds revenue engines for fast growing companies. Businesses hand us their entire sales function (strategy, automation, pipeline management, recruiting, training, and execution) so they can scale faster than they could on their own.

Our clients range from SaaS companies to education brands offering transformational programs in business, investing, entrepreneurship, and personal growth.

Why This Role Is Different

- Warm inbound and follow up leads every day, generated by proven marketing campaigns

- Hourly base pay plus uncapped commission, with $55,000-$70,000 OTE

- High ticket offers averaging $7k-$15k+ with a 10-14 day sales cycle

- Daily coaching and call reviews from experienced sales leaders

- A defined path from setter to closer for people who perform

- Fully remote from anywhere in the U.S., with a team that’s competitive, driven, and in it to win

A Day in the Life

You’ll start your morning with a team huddle to review targets and sharpen your approach. From there, most of your day is spent on the phone with leads who came in through ads, webinars, social media, and funnels. You’ll qualify their goals and buying intent, handle objections, and book them with a closer when they’re a fit. Between calls, you’ll work your pipeline follow ups, log activity in the CRM, and review recorded calls to keep getting better.

What You’ll Do

- Call warm leads at high volume and qualify them for fit and intent

- Book qualified appointments on closers’ calendars

- Work follow ups across the pipeline so no opportunity slips

- Track every touchpoint accurately in the CRM

- Participate in daily meetings, coaching sessions, and call reviews

- Partner with closers and leadership to improve show rates and conversions

- Consistently hit and exceed your appointment targets

What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days

- Days 1-30: Learn the offers, scripts, and CRM. Get comfortable at full call volume.

- Days 31-60: Hit your appointment targets consistently and handle objections with confidence.

- Days 61-90: Become a reliable source of qualified pipeline and start building toward closer readiness.

This Role Is a Great Fit If You...

- Are competitive and motivated by hitting numbers

- Genuinely enjoy phone conversations and objection handling

- Know that consistency and volume create results

- Want to grow into high ticket closing

- Take coaching well and apply it quickly

- Bring natural energy to every call

- Want to work alongside ambitious people

This Role Is Probably Not For You If You...

- Prefer unstructured work without clear metrics

- Struggle to stay consistent with follow up

- Need someone checking in on you throughout the day

- Let rejection throw off your day

- Aren’t comfortable spending most of your day on the phone

- Are looking for an easy remote job

What You Bring

- 6+ months of experience as an SDR, setter, or phone sales rep, ideally in high ticket

- Strong communication skills and confidence handling objections

- Experience working in a CRM

- The discipline to perform independently in a remote setting

- A high level of ownership and accountability

Compensation

- Base pay: $16.00 in most areas, but up to $22.00 per hour, depending on location (always at or above the applicable state and local minimum wage)

- Plus commission based on deals closed from your appointments

- On target earnings (OTE): $55,000-$70,000 per year

- Advancement into closing

description:
The Partner Sales Executive - Financial Services & Investment is key to executing Workiva ’s Partner Sales strategy across the Financial Services and Investment market. You will work directly with regional Sales and Alliance leaders to align partner strategies with field sales goals, which helps boost win rates and revenue for both Workiva and our partners. This role involves close collaboration with sales teams to drive strategic partner attachments, develop partner-sourced opportunities, and coordinate account planning activities across priority Financial Services and Investment accounts. Success is built on aligning efforts across Account Executives, Alliance Directors, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product teams, while developing strong relationships across the Financial Services partner ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

• Manage the day-to-day partner sales discussions across the Financial Services and Investment market, including pipeline and deal management, and ensure the commercial success of partnerships by working closely with regional sales leaders to align efforts with local goals

• Own partner-sourced pipeline development and co-sell execution across the Financial Services and Investment market, working with partners and sales teams to progress priority opportunities and deliver regional revenue goals

• Identify pipeline and partner coverage gaps and develop action plans in collaboration with sales leadership

• Engage in strategic account and whitespace planning sessions with partners and internal teams across priority Financial Services and Investment accounts

• Lead regional and account-level sales co-selling motions, ensuring the right partners are engaged effectively throughout the sales cycle

• Build and strengthen relationships with global and regional consulting, advisory, technology, and implementation partners serving Financial Services customers

• Engage senior stakeholders across partners and Financial Services customers to strengthen executive alignment and support strategic opportunities

• Assist with sales involvement in region-focused events, such as webinars and dinners, and collaborate on regional marketing initiatives with partners

• Track partner performance and ensure regional and solution commercial goals are met

• Develop a strong understanding of the Financial Services and Investment ecosystem to identify new partner-led growth opportunities

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of related experience in software, SaaS, and/or consulting, including selling to large enterprise commercial customers

• Experience working with or selling into Financial Services organisations, ideally across banking, insurance, asset management, investment management, or related sectors

• Extensive experience selling solutions through partner channels

• Undergraduate Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience in a related field

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience managing relationships between global consulting firms and software vendors, ideally within the Financial Services ecosystem

• Strong understanding of the Financial Services ecosystem and how consulting, advisory, and technology partners influence enterprise buying decisions

• Existing relationships within the Financial Services and/or Investment partner ecosystem are highly desirable

• Proven ability to develop and execute a strategy involving multiple stakeholders

• Self-motivated with a strong propensity for action, results, and continuous improvement

• Experience interacting cross-functionally in a matrix-oriented environment critical (including but not limited to sales, services, product, customer success, marketing, and operations)

• Ability to identify ways to successfully develop and execute a strategy

• Ability to engage and collaborate with senior leaders and external partners

• Negotiation, influencing, collaboration, and conflict resolution skills

title: Client Relations Specialist/Project Manager
description:
**This job opening will remain open until our growing team is fully staffed.**
We at Legacy Tree Genealogists love helping people all over the world (in over 50 countries!) discover their heritage. We get up in the morning and do things like tell a client her birth father’s name, connect cousins in China, and share documentation that an ancestor used an alias and actually fathered two families - at the same time, in two different countries. For over 20 years we’ve been changing people’s lives forever by answering some of their deepest questions.

Legacy Tree needs additional support to keep providing the highest-rated genealogy research in the world to our clients. This is where you come in! We need exceptional people on our Project Management team who are able to build and maintain solid trust-centered relationships with our clients.
About You:
This isn’t just a support role-it’s the heart of the client experience at Legacy Tree. You’ll be a great fit if:

• You’re a warm and professional communicator via phone, email, and text.

• You’re skilled at putting clients at ease and building their trust.

• You’re naturally empathetic and genuinely enjoy helping others.

• You have excellent attention to detail, can juggle multiple responsibilities gracefully, and excel at staying on top of deadlines.

• You’re comfortable following and improving internal processes.

• You stay calm under pressure and can de-escalate concerns with grace and patience.

• You enjoy learning new tools and systems and are comfortable navigating tech platforms.

• You’re passionate about genealogy and want to help others explore their family stories.

• You’re comfortable with Microsoft Office suite, particularly Word and PowerPoint (even better if that includes OneDrive), as well as Google Docs Editors suite including Google Docs and Google Sheets.

• You have experience with genealogy software (we use RootsMagic).

• You have a quiet, dedicated workspace, a reliable computer, at least two monitors, and strong internet access.

Even better if:

• You have a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience.

• You have personal or professional genealogical research experience.

• You have experience in customer service, hospitality, or another client-facing role.

• You’ve supported emotionally sensitive or personally meaningful client journeys.

If this doesn’t sound like you yet , don’t worry-we’re not going anywhere. You can sign up for notifications about future openings and check out other positions here.
What you’ll be doing at Legacy Tree:
At Legacy Tree, our clients are trusting us with something deeply personal-their family history. Your job is to make sure that experience feels supportive, professional, and inspiring from start to finish.
In this client-facing role, you will:

• Act as the main point of contact for clients, guiding them through each stage of their genealogy project.

• Build rapport with clients through clear, timely, and empathetic communication via email, phone, and video meetings.

• Onboard new clients by reviewing their goals, helping them navigate our New Client Checklist, and answering initial questions about the research process.

• Facilitate the smooth setup of each project by collecting and organizing client materials (documents, family trees, DNA access, etc.).

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure deliverables are clear, polished, and aligned with the client’s expectations.

• Review research results through the client’s lens-editing reports and updates as needed to ensure clarity, compassion, and professionalism.

• Troubleshoot concerns, address questions, and gently guide clients through unexpected findings with care and sensitivity.

• Support client reorders by recognizing their ongoing research needs and suggesting next steps when appropriate.

• Help maintain client satisfaction metrics, reorder rates, and internal communication logs using project management tools.

title: Platform Software Developer (AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes)
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a Software Developer to join our Unified Storage Layer (USL) Platform team and contribute to the development of Intelerad 's cloud storage solution for its cloud applications. In this role, you will design and deliver the storage services that support customers moving from traditional Intelerad deployments to our cloud platform. You will work within a cross-functional Agile team, taking full ownership of the feature development lifecycle and contributing to a platform that stores and serves medical imaging at scale.
Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain features for the Unified Storage Layer, taking full ownership from scoping through delivery - ensuring solutions are tested, documented, and meet sprint commitments.

• Translate complex support tickets and stakeholder requirements into well-engineered technical solutions, proactively identifying and resolving issues across the storage layer and its cloud infrastructure.

• Contribute to code quality through thorough pull request reviews and comprehensive documentation, supporting team-wide standards and knowledge sharing.

• Build and maintain the cloud infrastructure behind USL, including Kubernetes cluster design, automated provisioning with Terraform, AWS component tuning, and CI/CD pipeline management.

• Work across technologies, codebases, and cloud-native services, identifying opportunities for improvement and taking initiative to implement them within an Agile/Scrum workflow.

Qualifications & Experience

• 5+ years of professional commercial software development experience, or equivalent experience with a demonstrable track record of delivering production-quality software

• Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (e.g., EKS, RDS, S3, IAM) and Kubernetes, including infrastructure provisioning with Terraform

• Proven ability to work independently in a distributed team environment, managing priorities and delivering outcomes with minimal oversight

• Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex, long-term goals into well-scoped, deliverable increments

• Comfort working across multiple languages, frameworks, and problem domains as business needs evolve

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

• Development experience Kotlin or another similar JVM language

• Java, Spring Boot

• REST API and PostgreSQL database development expertise

• Container orchestration with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm

• Git/GitHub version control experience and familiarity with unit and integration testing best practices.

• Experience with Linux/Unix environments, shell scripting, and command-line tooling

• Experience with Agile/Scrum methodology in fast-paced development environments

• Background in healthcare technology: DICOM, HL7, medical imaging, or radiology workflow understanding

• Knowledge of IT security & authentication

• Aptitude with design & architecture

Consultant Gig #1037–AUS—NZ—EU—Executive Coach—Food Industry (European Expansion
description:
Client
An ICG client in the food and nutrition industry is seeking an experienced executive coach to work with its two senior executives as they lead the organisation through its next phase of international growth.
The business has developed its intellectual property and a proven model in its home market, and is now working to find product-market fit in Europe. Its two senior executives are based in different regions (New Zealand and Europe), and the organisation is focused on operating more effectively and efficiently as a global business.

The client’s hypothesis is that better integration of its regions and their different market cultures - and, by extension, of the leaders of those regions - will drive stronger growth in France, Belgium and Switzerland.

Role

This role is ideal for a senior coach who has personally lived the challenge of taking a business into France and wider European markets, and who can combine executive partnership coaching with credible, practical market insight.
You will coach the two senior executives as a leadership partnership, strengthening how they work together across regions, time zones and cultures. You will also help them build a better basis for deciding what to localise for European markets and what to retain from the home-market model - even where that differs from the traditional approach in a given market.
KEY FOCUS AREAS

• Strengthening the senior executive partnership - alignment, shared decision-making, roles and accountabilities, and effective collaboration across two regions.

• Integrating the regions and their market cultures, so that regional leadership and teams operate as one global organisation rather than parallel businesses.

• Building a robust, shared approach to “localise vs. retain” decisions as the business pursues product-market fit in France, Belgium and Switzerland.

• Deepening the executives’ understanding of European markets, customers and ways of working.

• Jointly developing the organisation’s own “standard” - culture, leadership and ways of working that hold across all markets.

KEY DELIVERABLE
A stronger, more effective senior executive partnership and a clearer, shared basis for international market decisions. Success will be reflected in a steeper growth curve in the European markets, a better understanding of those markets and how to operate in them, and a shared, articulated organisational standard for culture, leadership and ways of working.
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
Direct, hands-on experience of expanding a business into France and/or other EU markets is the most important requirement for this engagement. The client is looking for someone who has been accountable for (or worked closely alongside leaders accountable for) European market entry and growth - not solely an adviser or generalist coach.
This should be combined with a strong track record of coaching senior executives, ideally including leadership pairs, co-leaders or founder teams.

Logistics

Start Date: As agreed.
Duration: 3-6 months, as agreed.
Location: New Zealand and Europe - delivery can be fully remote
Delivery: Via video conferencing (e.g. Zoom / Microsoft Teams), with sessions scheduled across New Zealand and European time zones
Working Arrangements: Coaching engagement - joint partnership sessions with both executives, plus individual sessions as required, cadence to be agreed.
Rate: To be agreed with the client.
Close Date: No later than Thursday 12th, 5pm [NZDT]
APPLICATION PROCESS
Interested consultants should submit:

• CV highlighting European market expansion and executive coaching experience

● Brief cover note addressing:
o Specific, direct experience of expanding a business into France and/or the EU
o Examples of coaching senior leadership partnerships or executive teams
o Availability and day rate expectations

title: Supply Engineering Team Lead
description:
Crystalia Glass LLC is a U.S.-based manufacturer and provider of premium custom glass solutions for residential, commercial, and institutional projects. For more than 9 years, we have operated as a full-cycle company, managing every stage of the process-from design and manufacturing to sales, delivery, and installation. With production facilities in both the United States and Europe, we deliver high-quality solutions to customers across the U.S.
As our business continues to grow, we are expanding our Supply Engineering team and are looking for an experienced Supply Engineering Team Lead to help scale our operations, optimize supply processes, and lead a high-performing team.
The Role
The Supply Engineering Team Lead will report directly to the Chief Technical Officer and lead a team of four Supply Engineers .
Approximately 80% of the role focuses on team leadership, coordination, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration, while 20% involves hands-on supply engineering activities to support the team during peak workload, employee absences, or complex projects.
The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring efficient procurement operations, developing internal processes, and maintaining strong relationships with suppliers across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
Responsibilities
1. Procurement operations

• Launch production by coordinating glass orders and ensuring the availability of required hardware and materials.

• Plan inventory levels and forecast procurement needs.

• Review technical drawings and specifications to prepare accurate material lists.

• Verify dimensions, finishes, and quality requirements before placing orders.

• Track engineering documentation and procurement changes throughout the project lifecycle.

• Ensure procurement documentation and component orders are completed before production and container arrivals.

2. Supplier management

• Source, evaluate, and develop relationships with suppliers across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia .

• Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules.

• Manage purchasing activities for production, warehouse, and installation operations.

• Monitor supplier performance and resolve quality, logistics, and delivery issues.

• Identify opportunities to improve procurement efficiency, supplier performance, and cost optimization.

3. Cross-functional collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Project Managers, Engineers, Estimators, Warehouse, and Installation teams.

• Support engineering changes, material substitutions, and procurement planning.

• Provide procurement expertise, material recommendations, and pricing information for projects.

• Ensure purchased materials meet project specifications and technical documentation.

4. Team leadership

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four Supply Engineers.

• Assign tasks, prioritize workloads, and monitor project deadlines.

• Conduct regular one-on-one meetings and provide coaching and performance feedback.

• Review procurement documentation, material lists, and purchase orders prepared by the team.

• Support engineers with complex sourcing challenges and supplier escalations.

• Coordinate procurement activities with internal stakeholders across departments.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and optimize procurement workflows.

• Report progress, risks, and operational updates to the Chief Technical Officer.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in procurement, sourcing, or supply chain within the glass, glazing systems, architectural hardware, or closely related industries.

•
3+ years of people management experience , including direct leadership of procurement, sourcing, or supply teams.

• Proven experience building or scaling a procurement/sourcing function from scratch , including processes, workflows, supplier management standards, reporting, KPIs, and team structure.

title: Technical CRM Specialist
description:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role

Our CRM team is growing. We’re looking for a Technical CRM Specialist to join our affiliate marketing business in London.

This is an opportunity for someone with some experience with email marketing and knowledge of HTML, SQL and JavaScript, to support the team in delivering a customer-centric, automated experience across email, SMS, and messaging channels.

In this role, you’ll be supporting the CRM Technical Manager as well as CRM team and its wider ecosystem, using tools such as SparkPost, Email on Acid, Adobe, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, SMS integrations, Adobe Campaign and Rebrandly.

You’ll work on the end-to-end delivery of CRM initiatives that rely on data and systems so you must have the technical aptitude and knowledge with JavaScript, APIs and ideally base understanding of SQL. This includes managing incoming Jira tickets, monitoring daily campaigns, supporting the wider team, maintaining data quality and compliance, managing automations and integrations, overseeing IP warm-ups, and help build new HTML modules.

If you’re hands-on, data-driven, and comfortable operating across multiple technologies, with the coding skills listed, we’d like to hear from you.

 

Key responsibilities

- Internal SME of CRM-related systems

- Responsible for all data and compliance activities across CRM systems

- Supporting the CRM team with troubleshooting, training, and complex journey builds

- Managing new IP warm-ups

- QA for all data-related changes and system updates

- Monitoring all customer interactions

- Troubleshooting automation, journey, and HTML rendering issues

- Developing new HTML modules

- Work on launching SMS and potentially WhatsApp within Salesforce Marketing Cloud

- Working cross-functionally with Analytics, Product, and Technology teams to deliver effective, timely campaigns

- Developing and managing campaign audiences

 
 

Preferred Skills, Qualifications and Experience:

- Either Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) or Adobe Campaign working experience

- Strong data skills, including SQL and data quality control

- Good working knowledge of HTML for email

- Strong working knowledge of JavaScript

- Understanding and ideally exposure with APIs and working with JSON Objects

- Experience managing multiple priorities and adapting to changing requirements at short notice in a fast-paced environment

- Ability to work to tight deadlines, both independently and under pressure, to deliver results for stakeholders

- Commercially minded, data-literate, and highly analytical, with the ability to use raw data to generate insights and inform decisions

 

Nice to haves

- Previous experience in iGaming or a marketplace environment

- Strong understanding of email deliverability best practices, including IP warm-up, Google Postmaster, SNDS, and domain configuration

- Experience working across multiple brands, verticals, and locales

- Experience with SMS and WhatsApp channels

- Experience working in a target-driven, revenue-focused environment

What You’ll Get

- Private Health Care (Vitality)

- Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

- Travel Insurance

- Competitive Base Salary

- Company Bonus Scheme

- Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

- Market-Leading Training Pro
